goal: Same or better production code than Ponytail, not merely lower test churn

budget.stop: Stop on exhausted budget or genuine blockers, retain failures, publish unmet criteria honestly

arms.candidate: freeze after controlled reuse ablation and at most two revisions

sequence: Freeze independent tasks/oracles; failing-original negative controls
Reuse ablation: unchanged V3 versus removing only common-lifetime directive, two fresh tuning tasks (4 runs)
Independent tuning review; optional second revision with complete four-arm two-task tuning (8 runs)
Freeze candidate before reserve brief access
Two repeated complete four-task four-arm draws (32 runs); independent review after each
Publication hash/launcher audit, PR against main, owned cleanup

successGate.correctness: All required behavioral contracts, maintained regressions and affected consumers preserved; independent safety/readability/coverage review
successGate.production: Candidate production additions AND churn <= Ponytail in EACH final complete draw; report V3/V2 separately and individual case losses
successGate.combined: Candidate combined additions/churn <= Ponytail in EACH final draw without sacrificing meaningful regression coverage
successGate.bytes: Report exact resulting production and test/fixture/snapshot bytes and byte growth independently; no overall size win if byte result worsens
successGate.runtime: Entire automatically loaded skill plus references/scripts <=2642 UTF-8 bytes
successGate.noMetricGaming: Do not credit mere wrapping, deleted guards/comments, hidden JSON volume, complexity relocation or unmeasured performance

controls: Identical task/base/setup/dependency access/repo instructions/check command per case across arms
Fresh no-history Pi processes, explicit profiles, matched model/high reasoning/tools/time budget
No source repairs, cherry-picks or resampling an unchanged candidate until lucky
Frozen original results separate from common supplements applied to all relevant earlier arms
Reserve manifests separate, never aggregate before candidate freeze
No persona/grammar/presentation causal claims without independent content-controlled experiment
metrics: production resulting bytes and byte growth
mutation: Optional only if relevant installed manifests exist; no invented mutants
publication: extras/codingSessionV4 only for evidence, no generic benchmark framework, no README changes; archive all patches/briefs/oracles/frozen launchers including extensionless scripts/logs/hashes, exclude Ponytail source/profiles and credentials; describe non-hermetic paths/dependencies
